query: UPDATE diagrams SET title = $1, diagram_type = $2, data = CAST($3 AS jsonb), is_public = $4, updated_by = $5, updated_at = $6, version = version + $9 WHERE id = $7 AND version = $8 RETURNING version, created_at, updated_at
SELECT id, title, diagram_type, version, is_public, owner_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, data FROM diagrams WHERE id = $1
SELECT id, version_number, note, created_by, created_at, diagram_id, data FROM diagram_versions WHERE id = $1 AND diagram_id = $2

SELECT t.total, p.* FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total FROM diagrams WHERE owner_id = $1 AND title ILIKE $2 ESCAPE $7) t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, title, diagram_type, version, is_public, owner_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM diagrams WHERE owner_id = $3 AND title ILIKE $4 ESCAPE $8 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6) p ON $9

INSERT INTO diagram_versions (id, diagram_id, version_number, data, note, created_by, created_at) SELECT $1, d.id, COALESCE((SELECT max(version_number) FROM diagram_versions WHERE diagram_id = d.id), $6) + $7, d.data, $2, $3, $4 FROM diagrams d WHERE d.id = $5 RETURNING version_number, data

SELECT t.total, p.* FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total FROM diagrams WHERE is_public) t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, title, diagram_type, version, is_public, owner_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM diagrams WHERE is_public ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2) p ON $3

UPDATE diagrams d SET data = v.data, version = d.version + $5, updated_by = $1, updated_at = $2 FROM diagram_versions v WHERE d.id = $3 AND v.id = $4 AND v.diagram_id = d.id RETURNING d.id, d.title, d.diagram_type, d.data, d.version, d.is_public, d.owner_id, d.updated_by, d.created_at, d.updated_at

INSERT INTO diagram_versions (id, diagram_id, version_number, data, note, created_by, created_at) SELECT $1, d.id, COALESCE((SELECT max(version_number) FROM diagram_versions WHERE diagram_id = d.id), $6) + $7, d.data, $2, $3, $4 FROM diagrams d WHERE d.id = $5 RETURNING version_number
